abstract: We establish connections between dynamic mode decompositions (DMDs), vector autoregressions, and linear state-space models, showing that DMD provides a computationally efficient, SVD-based estimator of low-rank first-order VAR projection coefficients in high-dimensional settings. When the measurement matrix has full column rank, the recovered nonzero eigenvalues coincide with those of the underlying state transition matrix. We apply DMD to a 100-household heterogeneous-agent economy with complete markets and Gorman aggregation. From high-dimensional household income and consumption panels, DMD recovers latent aggregate dynamics, and cross-sectional loadings reveal the sharing rule governing redistribution, demonstrating DMD's capacity to extract economically meaningful structure from microeconomic panels.
abstract_zh: 我们建立了动态模式分解（DMDs）、向量自回归与线性状态空间模型之间的联系，表明在高维设定下，DMD提供了一种基于SVD的计算高效的低秩一阶VAR投影系数估计器。当测量矩阵具有满列秩时，恢复的非零特征值与底层状态转移矩阵的特征值一致。我们将DMD应用于一个包含100个家庭、具有完全市场和高尔曼聚合的异质性主体经济模型。从高维家庭收入与消费面板数据中，DMD恢复了潜在的总体动态，而横截面载荷揭示了支配再分配的共享规则，展示了DMD从微观经济面板中提取经济上有意义结构的能力。
title: Dynamic Mode Decompositions and Vector Autoregressions
title_zh: 动态模态分解与向量自回归

abstract: ETF market makers can satisfy excess demand in secondary markets by selling shares that are not yet created. While this ability to “operationally short” is not unique to ETFs, it plays a central role in ETF liquidity provision. We propose and validate a novel “operational shorting” measure. In addition to constituting a majority of ETF short interest, it is associated with higher retail trading activity and short-term return reversals, consistent with liquidity-supplying motives. Accounting for operational shorting is important in examining ETF returns, mispricing, and the asset-pricing implications of ETF trading on underlying securities.
abstract_zh: ETF做市商可以通过出售尚未创建的份额来满足二级市场的超额需求。尽管这种“操作性做空”的能力并非ETF独有，但它在ETF流动性提供中扮演着核心角色。我们提出并验证了一种新颖的“操作性做空”度量指标。除了构成ETF空头持仓的大部分外，该指标还与更高的散户交易活动和短期收益反转相关，这与流动性供给动机一致。在考察ETF收益、错误定价以及ETF交易对标的证券的资产定价影响时，考虑操作性做空至关重要。
title: Operational shorting and ETF liquidity provision
title_zh: 运营做空与ETF流动性提供

abstract: Since its independence in 1960, Mauritania has implemented several development strategies, the most recent being the Strategy for Accelerated Growth and Shared Prosperity (SCAPP 2016-2030). The SCAPP is structured around three strategic pillars, the second of which emphasizes the development of human capital and access to basic services. This underscores the relevance of examining the relationship between educational capital and economic growth in Mauritania over the period 1995-2024, in order to contribute to formulating recommendations and rethinking the existing strategic framework. This article investigates this relationship in both the short and long term through an ARDL (Auto-Regressive Distributed Lag) approach. Public expenditure on education is used as the explanatory variable of interest for educational capital, while the GDP growth rate is retained as the dependent variable measuring economic growth. The findings reveal a positive and statistically significant short-term relationship between educational capital and economic growth, with an estimated lag of two years. In the long term, however, the estimation indicates a negative and statistically significant relationship between educational capital and economic growth, attributable to the inefficiency of public education expenditure, which consists mainly of operating expenses.
abstract_zh: 自1960年独立以来，毛里塔尼亚实施了多项发展战略，最新的一项为《加速增长与共享繁荣战略（SCAPP 2016-2030）》。该战略围绕三大战略支柱构建，其中第二支柱强调人力资本开发及基本服务的获取。这凸显了考察1995-2024年间毛里塔尼亚教育资本与经济增长之间关系的现实意义，旨在为提出建议及反思现有战略框架作出贡献。本文通过ARDL（自回归分布滞后）方法，从短期和长期两个维度探究这一关系。公共教育支出作为教育资本的解释变量，而GDP增长率则作为衡量经济增长的被解释变量。研究结果显示，短期内教育资本与经济增长之间存在正向且统计显著的关系，估计滞后期为两年。然而，长期来看，估计结果表明教育资本与经济增长之间存在负向且统计显著的关系，这归因于公共教育支出的低效率，其构成主要为经常性支出。
title: IMPACT OF EDUCATIONAL CAPITAL ON ECONOMIC GROWTH IN MAURITANIA
title_zh: 毛里塔尼亚教育资本对经济增长的影响

title: Tackling Women’s Unemployment: Evidence from an Online Jobs Experiment in Bangladesh
title_zh: 解决女性失业问题：来自孟加拉国在线就业实验的证据

abstract: We test whether a conditional cash lottery targets prevention on those doing too little because of inverse-S probability distortion that also causes overvaluation of a lottery. Consistent with theory, Filipinos perceiving their cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk in a wide intermediate interval (10%, 85%] are 3 percentage points (60%) less likely to have a check-up before baseline if they exhibit inverse- S distortion. A random lottery offer conditional on going for a check-up (CVD screening) increases the probability by 47 points overall. Estimates of compliance and lottery-induced CVD preventive care are larger (not significantly) for inverse- S (but also S) types perceiving intermediate risk.
abstract_zh: 我们检验了条件现金彩票是否针对那些因逆S型概率扭曲而预防行为不足的个体，这种扭曲同时导致对彩票的高估。与理论一致，感知自身心血管疾病风险处于宽泛中间区间（10%，85%]的菲律宾人，若表现出逆S型扭曲，则在基线前接受体检的可能性低3个百分点（60%）。一项以接受体检（心血管疾病筛查）为条件的随机彩票提供，总体上将这一概率提高了47个百分点。对逆S型（也包括S型）且感知中等风险的个体，其依从性和彩票诱导的心血管疾病预防护理的估计值更大（虽不显著）。
title: Leveraging Probability Distortion to Target Prevention: A Cardiovascular Screening Experiment in the Philippines
title_zh: 利用概率扭曲进行定向预防：菲律宾心血管筛查实验

abstract: Our understanding of the relationship between the English patent system and technical change during the industrial revolution is based entirely on the study of successful patents. We address this feature by providing the first study of unsuccessful patent applications in England during the first industrial revolution. The paper presents a new hand‐collected dataset of 722 unsuccessful patent applications filed in England between 1783 and 1834, drawn from archival records of the Home Office. Combined with existing records of granted patents, we employ econometric analysis to empirically investigate the determinants of patent failure. Using natural language processing techniques to measure patent novelty, we find that more novel patents and patents originating from technological outsiders were more likely to fail. We also find early failure discouraged applicants from subsequent patenting attempts, although we find no evidence that failed applications were of a lower economic value than successful ones. Our findings are linked to a system of ex ante private opposition of patents, known as caveat opposition, specific to the English patent system at the time. We argue the caveat system served to block threatening competitors rather than filter out low‐quality patents. Private opposition, therefore, likely impeded knowledge diffusion during Britain's industrial revolution.
abstract_zh: 我们对工业革命期间英国专利制度与技术变革之间关系的理解，完全基于对成功专利的研究。我们通过首次对第一次工业革命期间英国未成功专利申请的研究来弥补这一空白。本文基于内政部的档案记录，提供了一个新手工收集的数据集，包含1783年至1834年间在英格兰提交的722项未成功专利申请。结合现有的授权专利记录，我们运用计量经济学分析，实证探究专利失败的 determinants。利用自然语言处理技术衡量专利新颖性，我们发现更新颖的专利和来自技术领域外部人士的专利更可能失败。我们还发现，早期失败抑制了申请人后续的专利申请尝试，尽管我们没有发现失败申请的经济价值低于成功申请的证据。我们的发现与当时英国专利制度特有的“预先私人异议”系统（即“警告异议”）相关联。我们认为，这一警告系统旨在阻止威胁性竞争者，而非筛选低质量专利。因此，私人异议很可能阻碍了英国工业革命期间的知识传播。
title: Success and failure in England's patent system: New evidence from patent applications, 1783–1834
title_zh: 英国专利制度的成功与失败：来自1783–1834年专利申请的新证据
